scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/contracts && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck -w packages/contracts -w backend -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run test -w packages/contracts -w backend -w frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run test:e2e -w backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run test:coverage -w packages/contracts -w backend -w frontend
